description:
Below are spaces for when you would like to display
items above the recovery items.
name: -----Consumables

description: Restores a small portion (25%) of an ally's HP.
name: Potion

description: Restores a moderate portion (50%) of an ally's HP.
name: Hi-Potion

description: Fully restores a single ally's HP.
name: Full Potion

description: Restores a small portion (25%) of an ally's MP.
name: Magic Water

description: Restores a moderate portion (50%) of an ally's MP.
name: Hi-Magic Water

description: Fully restores both HP and MP.
name: Elixir

description: Cures a target of Poison.
name: Antidote

description: Cures a target of Blindness.
name: Eye Drops

description: Cures a target of Silence.
name: Echo Herb

description: Revives a fallen ally with 20% HP.
name: Stimulant

description: Revives a fallen ally with full HP.
name: Potent Stimulant

description: Cures all negative status ailments.
name: Panacea

description: Cleanses target of stat-reducing debuffs.
name: Dispel Herb

description:
A mystical rope that guarantees instant escape from 
battle.
name: Escape Rope

description: A pungent spray that invigorates the user, granting 25 TP.
name: Repel Spray

A sticky green substance left behind by a Slime.

name: Green Gel

Shimmering dust from a forest fairy. Sells for a 
small amount of gold.
name: Fairy Dust

A noisy root pulled from the ground. Sells for a 
small amount of gold.
name: Mandrake Root

A dirty piece of fabric worn by goblins. Sells for a 
modest amount of gold.
name: Goblin Cloth

A heavy ivory tusk from a brutal Orc. Fetches a 
decent price.
name: Orc Tusk

A mystical bead carried by a Goblin Shaman. Fetches 
a decent price.
name: Shaman Bead

A glossy black feather from a giant crow. Merchants

A purse recovered from a Bandit. Contains various

A long, gross tail from a giant rat. Sells for a

A massive, sharp claw from a wild bear. Highly

A magical branch from a Treant that refuses to

A piece of the Forest Golem's armor. An incredibly
